research_mode: official Home Office and ONS primary statistical publications only; every claim carries a fail-closed limitation; no parcel score, exact incident location, candidate value or business result

sources.name: Police workforce release date
verified_claims: The Police workforce, England and Wales: 31 March 2026 bulletin was published on 22 July 2026.
limitations: Publication timing does not make national workforce data a parcel-level safety measure.

sources.name: Workforce coverage
verified_claims: The bulletin covers the 43 territorial police forces in England and Wales; British Transport Police and National Crime Agency figures are supplied separately and are largely excluded from the England and Wales headline totals.
limitations: Coverage and counting boundaries must be retained when comparing totals.

sources.name: Total paid police workforce
verified_claims: There were 234,441 FTE paid police workers in the 43 territorial forces at 31 March 2026, down 1,332 FTE or 0.6% from the previous year.
limitations: A national workforce total does not establish local response capacity for an individual property.

sources.name: Police officer total
verified_claims: There were 145,886 FTE police officers in the 43 territorial forces at 31 March 2026, down 566 FTE or 0.4% from the previous year.
limitations: Force deployment, demand and geography prevent direct conversion of the national total into parcel risk.

sources.name: Neighbourhood policing workforce
verified_claims: There were 20,989 FTE police officers and PCSOs in neighbourhood policing roles, 22.2% more than the 31 March 2025 baseline; 14,599 were officers and 6,390 were PCSOs.
limitations: The programme definition includes officers in training destined for neighbourhood roles and is not an exact local availability count.

sources.name: Frontline officer workforce
verified_claims: There were 115,764 FTE officers in frontline roles, down 1.3% from the previous year; 90.5% of officers were recorded in frontline roles.
limitations: The frontline classification is functional and does not indicate patrol presence at a specific address.

sources.name: Local policing function
verified_claims: There were 55,561 FTE officers in local policing roles, down 2,445 FTE or 4.2%; local policing accounted for 43.4% of officers.
limitations: Function-group totals are national aggregates and do not map directly to neighbourhood coverage.

sources.name: Investigations and public protection
verified_claims: There were 23,676 FTE officers in investigations and 15,298 FTE officers in public protection roles, representing 18.5% and 12.0% of officers respectively.
limitations: Functional staffing proportions do not measure incident probability or service quality at parcel level.

sources.name: Officers per resident population
verified_claims: The national rate was 236 FTE officers per 100,000 residents; the Metropolitan Police Service had 347 and Lincolnshire 152 per 100,000.
limitations: Police-force-area population rates are not interchangeable with exact-address safety scores.

sources.name: PCSO workforce
verified_claims: There were 7,259 FTE PCSOs at 31 March 2026, down 55 FTE or 0.8% from the previous year.
limitations: PCSO totals do not specify deployment, shift coverage or individual neighbourhood presence.
